Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve.
Asset type: single medieval RPG dialogue HEAD portrait for 74 x 100 logical pixels.
Input 1 is the exact identity reference ONLY. Inputs 2–5 are Mara, Ivo, Leiya, Tor coarse pixel portrait STYLE references ONLY, not identities or expressions. Substantively redraw the person as a tightly framed adult head; never crop/upscale the old full-body master. Preserve this person's specific facial identity, age, colors and character.
Composition: 74:100 portrait aspect. Very large face, almost hidden very short neck, clothing only a narrow bottom collar edge (bottom 6–8%); no broad shoulders/chest. The head fills the available height from roughly 3% through 91%. Mild three-quarter angle facing viewer left. All hair and ear contours fully contained with 3 logical pixel top and 2 pixel side transparent margins. Do not crop hair or ears to obtain the large face. No tall neck. Face bone planes dominate the image, not hair bulk.
Coarse hard-edged low-resolution pixel clusters, intentional stepped outlines, large connected cheekbone/nose bridge/nose-wing/eye-socket/jaw planes. Draw as if directly composed on a 74x100 pixel grid, even if output raster is larger. Skin has 4–6 broad hard flat tones. Temporary working palette at most 32 muted colors. Hair only 3–5 broad connected asymmetrical masses, very few wide stepped boundaries, no little parallel strands. Eyes small and dark, narrow subdued tan-gray sclera slivers rather than white rectangles, no bright pupil catchlight. No gradients, soft antialiasing, dithering, grain, microtexture, glossy highlights, fine isolated pixels, anime/chibi eyes or doll anatomy. Use adult bone structure.
One character, genuinely transparent background. No text, frame, props, hands, limbs, shoulder spread, scenery or effects. This is a newly generated drawing, followed by disclosed nearest-neighbor scaling/binary-alpha/no-dither palette derivation, not native pixel authorship.
Character: SINO / 司诺·庭 / ALD-NPC-SIN. A man in his THIRTIES, a local ceremony assistant, retaining the historically reviewed masculine visual proposal; the current card does not independently specify sex. Preserve short warm chestnut-brown side-parted hair, clean-shaven narrow/long adult face, softly angular slender jaw, a distinct straight medium-long nose and warm tan skin. Broader mature cheek/nose shadow planes than the cute old full-body drawing. Do not make him a teenager or old man.
Expression is practiced mild courteous interest with a small CLOSED asymmetrical half-smile and alert appraising gaze slightly left, wanting assent without being smug. Brows are relaxed almost level with a slight single outer lift; NO raised inner ends forming a worried V, NO saintly smile, sneer, grief, anger or excessive wrinkles. Distinct from Sore's focused unsmiling firmer-jawed face.
Only a tiny dark charcoal ritual-robe collar with muted off-white lining and thin rust-red UNPATTERNED stole corners along bottom. Upright, measured, self-possessed manner. No religious symbol, crown, clerical luxury, document, bracelet, hands or public mourning scene. Ceremony participation is voluntary and must not imply compensation permission or completed reconciliation.
